acceptableAnswerCriteria: Explains that withholding is set per employer against that employer’s payments, so income reported on a 1099 has nothing withheld and the shortfall only appears when the 1040 combines both.

Notes that this is a timing and cash-planning problem rather than an extra tax: the same $4,144.00 was owed either way.

lookFors: The response distinguishes owing tax from owing a penalty; nothing here says the filer was penalised.
